checkpoints.quote: statements-api-after.log shows GetStatementLineQuery taking **33,757ms** (33.7s) and **36,388ms** (36.4s) in the GetStatementLineQuery request (threshold: 10,000ms). statements-api-before.log shows GetStatementLineQuery taking **<312ms** (e.g., 281ms) across multiple requests.
checkpoints.reason: The baseline is roughly correct (~300 ms) but the after window is only cited as 33–36 s, omitting the full range up to ~73 s (72,974 ms).
The analysis never quantifies the slowdown as a multiplier (e.g., ~100×, ~110×, ~240×); it only gives raw millisecond values.
The analysis does not describe the progressive worsening within the after window (35 s → 44 s → 69–73 s); it only cites two mid-range values.

checkpoints.quote: the migration may have introduced the regression
checkpoints.reason: The migration is identified as a likely suspect with appropriate hedging ('may have'), but the analysis does not explicitly state that the logs only show coincidence, not causation.

The analysis does not discuss the limitations of the comparison (short ~5-minute windows, different days, few samples, no data in between) or note that the regression size is indicative rather than measured.

ThreadPool starvation is not mentioned at all, so it is not named as a root cause.
